# Hackbarth Delivery Service, Inc.

Hackbarth Delivery Service, Inc. is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Hackbarth Delivery Service specializes in last mile delivery, logistics, warehousing, distribution, and transportation. Hackbarth Delivery Service, Inc. employs 281 people and has an annual revenue of $29.2M, founded in 1975. Headquartered in Mobile, Alabama, United States.

## About

Established in 1975, Hackbarth Delivery Service, Inc. is your single-source solutions provider for all transportation, logistics, warehousing and distribution needs. Specializing in Last Mile Delivery, we are a Privately-Held, Certified Woman-Owned Corporation by the WBENC and SmartWay Partner. Reach out to our Service Center where your inquiries are met with a live voice from our courteous and professional team. 
Established in 1975, we have had continuous financial and physical growth. Starting with only $500 and one blue van, Hackbarth currently has 41 terminal/cross dock locations, more than 250 employees and over 1100 drivers allowing us to provide Customized Logistics Solutions and White Glove Services across 11 states - Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, Ohio, Tennessee, Texas and West Virginia.
Our delivery and logistics solutions are tailored to meet the individual needs of each customer, and our mix of 85% independent contractors and 15% employee drivers currently deliver over 110,000 packages a day and complete more than 4 millions final mile deliveries a year across the Southeast, Midwest and Mid-Atlantic US Regions. 
We are on a mission to provide the highest level of customer service - employing technology to drive efficiency, optimization and complete visibility to all customers. We invested in innovative, high-tech technology, utilizing Key Software's Xcelerator Dispatch Software and MobileTex app, along with Appian Routing Software, in order to provide customers with the best, most cost-effecient logistics solutions and real-time updates for every delivery. 
Call or email us today, and join the Hackbarth Highway to give your customers KYSO®(Knock Your Socks Off) Service and achieve reduced costs.

results.text:
# Hegarty's Delivery Service, Inc.

Hegarty's Delivery Service, Inc. is a Freight and Package Transportation company. HDS is a same-day courier and trucking services company with 46 years of experience in New England. They offer efficient same-day shipping and provide Rush Hot Shot Delivery and Final Mile Delivery. Hegarty's Delivery Service, Inc. employs 5 people (+25.0% YoY, +1 person), founded in 1980. Headquartered in Stoneham, Massachusetts, United States.

## About

Hegarty's Delivery Service, Inc. (HDS) has been supporting New England operations for over 46 years with reliable same-day courier and dedicated trucking solutions.

We specialize in time-critical shipments, plant transfers, recovery moves, fleet replacement and dedicated vehicle services, handling everything from a single package to full 26-foot truckloads across all of New England.

We utilize a fleet of:
- Cars
- SUVs
- Cargo vans
- Sprinter vans
- 26-foot box trucks

Many companies rely on HDS when shipments are urgent, schedules change, or regular carrier capacity becomes tight.

What makes HDS different:
- Same-day courier and trucking under one provider
- Dedicated vehicle service
- Full New England coverage
- TSA-certified drivers for secure freight
- Fast dispatch and direct deliveries
- Family-owned and operated since 1980

We support leading medical device, manufacturing, air/ocean freight, supply/distribution, and technology companies throughout New England with shipments that simply cannot miss.

If you are looking for a reliable same-day logistics partner or a strong backup option when your regular carrier falls short, give us a call. We pick up.
